easy.label: Easy
easy.blurb: The first hundred episodes. Nothing spoiled past Alabasta.

questions.q: What is Luffy's dream?
a: To become King of the Pirates
To draw a map of the world
questions.note: He says it out loud to anyone who will listen.

questions.q: Which Devil Fruit did Luffy eat?
questions.note: Gomu Gomu no Mi. It made him rubber.

questions.q: What can Devil Fruit users never do again?
questions.note: The sea takes their strength away.

questions.q: Who gave Luffy his straw hat?
questions.note: Shanks got it from Roger, and Luffy has to give it back one day.

questions.q: What is Zoro's fighting style?
questions.note: Santoryu. The third sword goes in his mouth.

questions.q: What job does Nami do on the crew?
questions.note: She wants to map the entire world.

questions.q: What job does Sanji do on the crew?
questions.note: And he only fights with his legs, to protect his hands.

questions.q: What kind of animal is Chopper?
questions.note: Everyone calls him a tanuki. He hates it.

questions.q: Which sea does the crew come from?
questions.note: The weakest of the four seas, supposedly.

questions.q: What is Usopp's role on the ship?
questions.note: A liar with perfect aim.

questions.q: What is Buggy's Devil Fruit power?
a: He can split his body apart
questions.note: Chop-Chop Fruit. Slashing attacks do nothing to him.

questions.q: What species is Arlong?
questions.note: A sawshark fish-man, and the reason Nami joined the crew.

questions.q: What is the crew's first proper ship called?
questions.note: A gift from Kaya.

questions.q: Who is the strongest swordsman in the world, and Zoro's goal?
questions.note: Zoro loses to him early and asks him to teach him later.

questions.q: What is Luffy's grandfather Garp's job?
questions.note: Which makes family dinners complicated.

questions.q: What is Sanji's restaurant home called?
questions.note: A floating restaurant that fights back.

questions.q: What is the treasure everyone is looking for?
questions.note: Left at Laugh Tale by Gol D. Roger.

questions.q: What did Nami spend years doing for Arlong?
questions.note: While secretly stealing to buy her village back.

medium.label: Medium
medium.blurb: Everything through Water 7, Sabaody and Marineford.
medium.spoiler: Spoilers up to and including Marineford.

questions.q: Which Warlord secretly ran the country of Alabasta?
questions.note: Under the name Mr. 0, boss of Baroque Works.

questions.q: What is Enel's Devil Fruit power on Skypiea?
questions.note: Goro Goro no Mi. It also lets him hear everything on the island.

questions.q: What is Franky's real name?
questions.note: Tom gave it to him. He buried the name to stay hidden.

questions.q: Which organisation does Rob Lucci belong to?
questions.note: Government assassins with the licence to kill.

questions.q: How did the crew say goodbye to the Going Merry?
questions.note: And the ship apologised to them first.

questions.q: What is the great underwater prison called?
questions.note: Six levels down, and Level 6 is not on any official record.

questions.q: What was Whitebeard's real name?
questions.note: The man closest to One Piece, who never wanted it.

questions.q: Which Devil Fruit did Ace have?
questions.note: Mera Mera no Mi. Losing to magma is exactly as bad as it sounds.

questions.q: Who was Fleet Admiral of the Marines during the Marineford war?
questions.note: He resigned after it.

questions.q: Where did Luffy's crew get separated for two years?
questions.note: Kuma sent every one of them flying to a different place.

questions.q: What is Nico Robin's profession?
questions.note: The only person alive who can read Poneglyphs.

questions.q: What does a Poneglyph record?
a: History erased by the World Government
questions.note: The Void Century, written in a language nearly nobody can read.

questions.q: What is Bartholomew Kuma's Devil Fruit power?
questions.note: Nikyu Nikyu no Mi. He can repel pain and air itself.

questions.q: Which admiral has magma powers?
questions.note: Sakazuki, later Fleet Admiral.

questions.q: Who was Gol D. Roger's first mate?
questions.note: The Dark King, working as a coating craftsman when Luffy meets him.

questions.q: What is Gecko Moria's power on Thriller Bark?
questions.note: Kage Kage no Mi. It is how Brook lost his.

questions.q: Which island is ruled by fish-men and mermaids?
questions.note: Ten thousand metres under the sea.

questions.q: Who ate the Ope Ope no Mi?
questions.note: The fruit that can grant immortality — to someone else.

hard.label: Hard
hard.blurb: Wano, Egghead, and things the anime took twenty years to say out loud.
hard.spoiler: Heavy spoilers, right up to the current arc.

questions.q: What is the true name of Luffy's Devil Fruit?
questions.note: Hito Hito no Mi, Model: Nika. The World Government hid it for eight hundred years.

questions.q: What is Kaido's Devil Fruit?
questions.note: Uo Uo no Mi, Model: Seiryu. A fish fruit, of all things.

questions.q: How many Road Poneglyphs point to Laugh Tale?
questions.note: You need all four to triangulate the island.

questions.q: Who was the captain of the Rocks Pirates?
questions.note: Beaten by Roger and Garp together at God Valley.

questions.q: What name did Law know Doflamingo's younger brother by?
questions.note: Donquixote Rosinante, who died so Law could live.

questions.q: What is the elephant carrying the country of Zou called?
questions.note: Punished a thousand years ago and still walking.

questions.q: What is Sanji's family name?
questions.note: Germa 66, the killer army he ran away from.

questions.q: Which ancient weapon is hidden in Wano?
questions.note: The blueprints were what got Water 7 into so much trouble.

questions.q: Who executed Kozuki Oden?
questions.note: After Oden boiled for an hour holding his retainers above the oil.

questions.q: What is Zoro's cursed sword called?
questions.note: He picked it by throwing it in the air and holding out his arm.

questions.q: Which Straw Hat carries the sword Wado Ichimonji?
questions.note: It was Kuina's. He promised he would carry it to the top.

questions.q: What is Sabo's rank in the Revolutionary Army?
questions.note: Second only to Dragon.

questions.q: How many satellites of Vegapunk are there?
questions.note: Shaka, Lilith, Edison, Pythagoras, Atlas and York.

questions.q: What does Big Mom's Soul-Soul Fruit take?
questions.note: Soru Soru no Mi. She takes years off people and gives them to objects.

questions.q: Who is the current Fleet Admiral of the Marines?
questions.note: Akainu, after beating Aokiji on Punk Hazard.

questions.q: What is Kaido's crew called?
questions.note: Organised by Devil Fruit rank: Gifters, Pleasures, Waiters.

questions.q: Which Straw Hat's shadow was stolen and put in a zombie?
questions.note: Which is why he is a walking skeleton with a shadow to reclaim.

questions.q: What is the name of the world's oldest and largest tree, holding centuries of books?
a: The Tree of Knowledge at Ohara
questions.note: Burned down with the island by a Buster Call.
